title: A Young Man in a Large Hat

events.t: A Young Man in a Large Hat

events.n: date from P571 inception: 1628; stated in Frans Hals catalog raisonné, 1974

events.n: [1] According to Hans Schneider, "Ein neues Bild von Frans Fals," _Kunstchronik und Kunstmarkt_ 30 (1918-1919), 368, who persuaded his relative to lend the painting for a while to the Mauritshuis. Later references to earlier owners Van der Hoop and Slochteren (see Seymour Slive, _Frans Hals_, 3 vols., London and New York, 1970-1974, 3: 41-42, no. 66) cannot be confirmed.
events.q: C.J.G. Bredius, Woerden, by 1918.
